records.name: Bog Totem
records.description: The Fatemaker summons a Bog Totem Companion at target location, which periodically creates Elemental Bog Spirits that seek out nearby enemies, dealing Ability Damage and exploding on impact. Bog Totem has multiple charges, and pinging an enemy will cause your Bog Totem to target them. Duration Restored on Kill: 10.0% Duration: 15 seconds Cooldown: 45 seconds Charges: 2 Max Bog Totems: 4

records.name: Plaguestorm

Elemental Bolts can't apply Status Effects . Damage Stored: 25.0% of Damage Dealt Duration: 20 seconds Cooldown: 60 seconds
